items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Because I worked with Bill and when I had the band out at the roadhouse, the Thomas Roadhouse... Bill used to get, when somebody would come in and want to sit in, he'd come over and play with me over at the Thomas Roadhouse.

ctx.x: Did we say anything about Bill Krieger when the machine was on? I know we were talking about him before.
Bill Krieger was one of the finest, you don't have it on now y'all?
Yeah, yeah, we have it on now.
